name: cart-button
title: Cart Button
description: A compact cart of three grocery items with an Add button on each row. Pressing Add turns the button into a minus, count and plus, and the subtotal and checkout total update.
use: A short product list needs inline quantity control and a running total without a full cart page.
avoid: Item names, prices and icons are baked into the default array, so a real shop must supply its own list.
a11y: Quantity buttons are labelled, totals are live, and motion honours reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded panel lists three items, each with a tinted icon tile, name, price and detail, and a round pill button on the right. A footer row holds the subtotal and a white Checkout button.
behaves: Pressing Add widens the pill into a minus, quantity and plus; holding either end repeats. The count rolls digit by digit and the subtotal and Checkout sum update, while a limit message appears at the maximum.
customise: Pass an items array, starting quantities, currency and a checkout callback; icon tints and layout classes are in the source.
weight: light: Three rows with a few width and roll animations; idle when untouched.
